findings.title: Powerful capability exposed: network-egress
findings.description: Tool `gzip-file-as-resource` appears to offer network-egress. In an agent, a prompt-injected instruction could invoke it against the operator's intent.
findings.recommendation: Gate this tool behind an authorization scope or human confirmation; constrain its inputs.
